name: open-fast-domotic
description: Local home automation hub: Python (FastAPI, zigpy-znp) server and React (Vite) client.

scripts.start: npm run build:client && cross-env STATIC_DIR=../client/dist node scripts/python.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
